item.title: Softail Smorgasbord: Explore the 2025 Range Now in Australia
item.description: It was back in 2018 when we saw the huge overhaul of the Softail range, and this year, H-D have done it again. With more power, new riding modes and upgraded suspension, it really is a Softail Smorgasbord, with each model appealing to different riders in their own way. This year, all six models do away with the 107ci and 114ci displacements and now come in three tailored variants of the 117ci engine, with each providing more power and torque.
